name: brainfreeze-algos-frontend-build
description: Build-only tooling. Brainfreeze Algos is a Flask app; Node/npm is used here solely to bundle the CodeMirror 6 editor into a single local file (static/js/vendor/codemirror-bundle.js) so the browser doesn't load CodeMirror's sub-packages from several independent CDN URLs at runtime, which caused mismatched versions of shared internals (@codemirror/state, @codemirror/view, @codemirror/language) to load side by side and break CodeMirror's identity checks. Re-run `npm run build:editor` after installing (npm install) whenever editor.js's CodeMirror version pins change.
